prompt.alinti: Kiln is the text-to-3D tool that lets language models build game-ready models by writing code and checking their own work.
Instead of just guessing its shapes, the AI writes JavaScript programs to construct geometry, renders those models to look at them, and then fixes its mistakes.
It creates actual usable files that drop straight into game engines without cleanup.
If you have ever wondered how to get high-quality 3D assets from text prompts, Kiln is the project to watch.

yontem.ne: Text-to-3D model oluşturma ve kodlama yoluyla denetimli geliştirme.
yontem.alinti: The agent writes JavaScript using Kiln's geometry and material helpers.

yontem.ne: AI'nin yazdığı JavaScript programı çalıştırarak geometriyi oluşturur, render eder ve hataları düzeltir.
yontem.alinti: Kiln runs the program and returns rendered views and structural checks so the agent can review its work.

yontem.ne: Üretilen 3D modeli GLB formatında dışa aktarır ve kaynak kodunu değiştirmek için saklar.
yontem.alinti: Export the asset as a GLB and keep the source for later changes.

yontem.ne: Kiln'in yerel olarak çalışması (MCP server, CLI, TypeScript library ve araçlar içermesi).
yontem.alinti: Kiln runs locally. It includes an MCP server, a CLI, a TypeScript library, and skills for authoring, editing, animation review, and scene composition.

yontem.ne: Kiln'in ayrı bir model API anahtarı gerektirmemesi.
yontem.alinti: Kiln does not require a separate model API key for its tools.
